verdict.rationale: Bento has built-in AI behavior you can hand work to in plain English. You describe a failure mode and it trains, fires and backfills a signal [docs-4]. Alerts written in English are grouped into incidents and judged real or benign automatically [docs-7]. It also proposes and shadow-tests fixes that graduate to full traffic only if they help [docs-11, docs-12]. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant you can delegate arbitrary tasks to. Its agent-facing tooling (Agent Skills, MCP docs) targets external agents like Claude Code rather than a built-in assistant [docs-1, docs-2]. Missing for 10: a documented general in-product assistant or chat interface, open-ended task delegation beyond signal/alert/fix workflows, and independent corroboration.
